observations: Two stacked white plastic IBC tanks with metal cage frames.
The tanks show visible dirt, algae, and some discoloration, especially on the lower tank.
The lower tank has a blue spigot and a white cap; the upper tank has a blue spigot and a white cap.
Labels are present on both tanks, but text is not legible.
The tanks are placed on a concrete floor next to a wall with mossy blocks.
The metal frames show rust and wear, especially at the base and corners.
The tanks appear to be used and may have structural or material degradation.

claims.claim: Iron reinforced white plastic tank for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show white plastic IBC tanks with metal cage frames, consistent with iron-reinforced plastic tanks.

claims.claim: It can be used for fish pond, water storage, diesel...
claims.evidence: The tanks appear used and show signs of algae and dirt, which may affect suitability for fish ponds or water storage. The claim about diesel is not supported by visible evidence.

risks.risk: Structural damage or corrosion in the metal cage frame.
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the metal frame, especially at joints and base, to check for cracks, rust, or warping.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially compromised, with reduced value for safety and durability

risks.risk: Internal contamination or leakage due to algae and dirt buildup.
risks.proof: Interior view of the tanks, showing condition of the plastic walls and any signs of leakage or contamination.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unusable for clean water storage or fish ponds

risks.risk: Damaged or missing spigots, affecting functionality.
risks.proof: Close-up of the spigots on both tanks, showing condition and whether they are intact and functional.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional for water storage

proof_requests: Close-up of the metal cage frame to check for rust, cracks, or structural damage.
Interior view of the tanks to assess cleanliness and potential leaks.
Close-up of the spigots to confirm they are intact and functional.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
